name: TransferType
help: Choose download or a single-file upload. UploadReply also receives a server reply.

name: Priority
help: Foreground competes for bandwidth. High, Normal and Low use available background bandwidth.

name: Asynchronous
help: Return a BITS job immediately. Finish it with Complete-BitsTransfer only after its state is Transferred.

name: Suspended
help: Create a paused job. Resume it from PowerShell when ready.

name: DisplayName
help: Give the job a recognizable name.

name: Description
help: Describe the transfer, up to 1,024 characters.

name: RetryInterval
help: Seconds between attempts after a temporary error. The minimum is 60 seconds.

name: RetryTimeout
help: Seconds allowed after the first temporary error. Zero disables retries.

name: MaxDownloadTime
help: Maximum transfer duration in seconds.

name: TransferPolicy
help: Choose the network cost policy. Always can use metered or roaming connections.

name: ProxyUsage
help: Use system proxy settings, bypass the proxy, detect it, or supply an override.

name: ProxyList
help: One proxy URI or host:port per line. Requires ProxyUsage Override.

name: ProxyBypass
help: One host pattern per line to connect directly. Requires ProxyUsage Override.

name: Authentication
help: Choose server authentication. Basic should be used only with HTTPS.

name: Credential
help: Prompt for server credentials in PowerShell when the command runs. No password is saved.

name: ProxyAuthentication
help: Choose proxy authentication. Prefer Negotiate or Ntlm on managed networks.

name: ProxyCredential
help: Prompt for proxy credentials in PowerShell when the command runs. No password is saved.

name: Dynamic
help: Allow a download whose server content changes. Check the server's BITS support.

name: WhatIf
help: Ask PowerShell to describe the operation without creating a transfer.

name: Confirm
help: Ask PowerShell for confirmation before creating the transfer.

name: Source
help: Edit the source file list above; each source is paired with a destination.

name: Destination
help: Edit the destination file list above; supply a complete filename for each source.

name: ACLFlags
help: Security descriptor copying is not enabled in this command designer.

name: SecurityFlags
help: Certificate validation and redirect overrides are not enabled.

name: UseStoredCredential
help: Stored credentials are not offered. Use the PowerShell credential prompt option.

name: HttpMethod
help: Custom HTTP methods force foreground priority and are not enabled in this designer.

name: CustomHeaders
help: Custom headers may contain credentials and are not collected or stored.

name: CustomHeadersWriteOnly
help: Requires custom headers, which are not enabled in this designer.

name: NotifyCmdLine
help: Post-transfer program execution is not enabled.

name: NotifyFlags
help: Job notification configuration is not enabled.

name: CertStoreLocation
help: Client certificate selection is not enabled.

name: CertStoreName
help: Client certificate selection is not enabled.

name: CertHash
help: Client certificate selection is not enabled.
